rows.en: <operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Hey, <color(4)>Faye<ce()>, what in the world are these <color(6)>unidentified life-forms<ce()>, anyway?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>We still don't really know. Only that they're life-forms born from meteorites that came from beyond the atmosphere...
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>So, aliens? We had more than enough of those with <color(5)>Boddole Zer<ce()>.
<operator(10030,2)><speed(2)>More to the point, <color(4)>Faye<ce()>, this is your first real battle, right? We'll back you up all we can.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>With all of you who beat <color(5)>Boddole Zer<ce()> beside me, I'll be fine. You're so kind, <color(4)>Light<ce()>.

uncertainties.issue: 'unidentified life-forms' follows the hyphenated form in meeting_briefing_015; encyclopedia_022 prose uses 'Unidentified life forms' (no hyphen). No glossary entry locks it.
'meteorites that came from beyond the atmosphere' - source says life-forms arising from meteorites that flew in from outside the atmosphere; compressed.

checked_decisions: 0/19 'unidentified life-forms': hyphenated lowercase form is the corpus majority (11 vs 3 vs 2) and no glossary lock; kept. Name-script matter, not meaning.

0/20 meteorite line: 'born from meteorites that came from beyond the atmosphere' carries every element of the source (origin outside atmosphere, meteorites, life arising from them, 'only that...' trailing). Accepted.
'Boddole Zer' matches the 7 other corpus uses; Faye's polite register toward the Dragonar trio and '-san' on Light dropped - acceptable.
